thread:
Headless WordPress Hosting: The Architecture and the Two Things You Now Host

Quick thread 🧵
Headless WordPress keeps WordPress as the content backend (PHP and MySQL, the admin you know) and moves the public site to a separate front-end app that pulls content over the REST API or WPGraphQL.
The catch: you now host two things, a WordPress backend and a decoupled front end.
Keep them on one platform so they talk over a fast private link.
And skip headless entirely if you lean on page builders or you're building a small site.
